text: Cooking is the art of transforming raw ingredients into delicious meals using heat and natural flavors. One of the most essential base ingredients in any culinary creation is garlic, whose sharp fragrance and unique flavor elevate any dish. Following closely is onions, whose soft layers and sweet scent add depth and warmth to a variety of recipes. Together, garlic and onions form the foundation of countless cuisines, from Italian to Spanish and every culinary tradition in between, offering endless possibilities for creativity and delight. Whether used raw, sautéed, or caramelized, their versatile textures and fragrances make them indispensable in the kitchen.
